title: Жизнь тогда и сейчас (Промпт)
description: Скопируй промпт в чат с ИИ и обсуди, как изменилась жизнь подростков. Станция засчитывается, когда ты реально поговорил.

promptCard.prompt: Ты — мой сверстник из англоговорящей страны. Мне ___ лет. Давай поговорим о том, как изменилась жизнь за последние годы. Что нового появилось и как подростки сейчас живут. Отвечай на мои вопросы и задавай свои на эту тему. Используй Present Perfect Continuous и Present Perfect, Past Simple. Исправь меня, если я ошибусь, но только в конце нашего диалога и в очень дружеской форме)

extra.title: Dialogue: “Life Then and Now”
lines: Alex: Hey, Jamie! Our teacher asked us to think about how teenagers' life has changed. What's your opinion?
Jamie: Hi Alex! Well, it's totally different now. Teens have been growing up with gadgets everywhere.
Alex: Yeah, before, they hung out in parks, rode bikes and just talked. Now many prefer gaming or streaming videos.
Jamie: Exactly. And they have been sharing almost everything on TikTok or Snapchat. Some people care more about likes than real conversations.
Alex: True. But there are good sides too. Teens have been discovering new hobbies online, like drawing, coding or music.
Jamie: For sure. Before, they joined local clubs or sports teams. Now you can learn anything from YouTube or special apps.
Alex: I think life is more fun now, but also more distracting.
Jamie: I agree. Before, there were fewer choices, but also less pressure. Now we can do more, but we also feel we must always be active online.
Alex: So, both advantages and disadvantages?
Jamie: Definitely. It's all about how you balance your time.
